title: WASH preparedness learning playbook
useCase: Campus or civic groups preparing a non-medical public-health learning session.
steps: Route action through reviewed WASH partners.

title: Education recovery learning playbook
useCase: Teachers, universities, and partners exploring temporary learning support.
steps: Review temporary learning and psychosocial support resources.
Draft partner questions before any program design.

title: Technology safeguards playbook
useCase: University labs and technologists building public-interest prototypes.
steps: Do not expose locations or beneficiary identities.
Secure partner review before any deployment.
